title: RLinf/RLinf
abstract:
RLinf: Reinforcement Learning Infrastructure for Embodied and Agentic AI

[ ](README.md) [ ](README.zh-CN.md) RLinf: Reinforcement Learning Infrastructure for Embodied and Agentic AI RLinf is a flexible and scalable open-source RL infrastructure designed for Embodied and Agentic AI. The 'inf' in RLinf stands for `Infrastructure`, highlighting its role as a robust backbone for next-generation training. It also stands for `Infinite`, symbolizing the system’s support for open-ended learning, continuous generalization, and limitless possibilities in intelligence development. ## What's NEW! - [2026/10] 🎉 RLinf v0.4 is released, taking RL out of simulation and into agile control of the physical world. Highlights: a modular real-robot system (`rlinf.robotics`), real-robot SOTA post-training algorithms (RLT, STEAM, OPD, RTC), full-modality models (native PyTorch OpenPI π₀ / π₀.₅, Cosmos3, FastWAM, π₀-FAST, Evo-1, MolmoAct2, SD3 / Wan2.2), and eight accelerator backends. Release notes: [RLinf v0.4](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/resources/release_v0.4.html). - [2026/10] 🎉 RLinf introducing **CEL** (Collective Experience Learning): robot fleets improve a shared policy from their own deployment experience without additional expert demonstrations or corrective actions, validated on up to 96 real robots across 5 real-world tasks. Project page: [CEL](https://cel-robot-learning.github.io/), paper: [arXiv:2610.25736](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25736). Code will release soon. - [2026/10] 🔥 RLinf supports MetaX (MACA) GPUs. PR: [MetaX GPU support (#1656)](https://github.com/RLinf/RLinf/pull/1656). - [2026/09] 🔥 RLinf refactors real-world robots and environments, using a unified robotics interface to manage hardware, tasks, and rollout wrappers separately. Docs: [Robotics Interface](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/concepts/robotics.html), [Robotics Architecture](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/concepts/robotics_architecture.html), [Real-World Tasks and Environments](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/lates
abstract_zh: RLinf是一个灵活且可扩展的开源强化学习基础设施，专为具身与智能体AI设计。名称中的“inf”代表“Infrastructure”（基础设施），强调其作为下一代训练稳健后端的角色；同时也代表“Infinite”（无限），象征系统对开放式学习、持续泛化以及智能发展无限可能性的支持。最新进展包括：支持GR00T-N1.7、Polaris模拟器、Genesis等平台的强化学习微调；通过系统级优化（精简、按需观测、混合流水线并行），在BEHAVIOR模拟器上实现了端到端加速，将rollout延迟从1028.7毫秒/步降至41.2毫秒/步。
tldr_zh: RLinf是面向具身与智能体AI的开源强化学习基础设施，支持多种平台并实现显著加速。
